text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a fluid, light powder-blue floral dress with a deep V neckline and soft short flutter sleeves. The dress has a loose, elongated silhouette that falls from the shoulders without a defined waist, printed all over with scattered botanical florals in muted peach, brown, gray, and black tones. A prominent front overlay forms a cape-like or ruffled bib effect across the chest and upper torso, edged with a strong black border that creates angular lines down toward the center front. The skirt falls to ankle length with an irregular, handkerchief-like drape and asymmetric movement, revealing contrasting black fabric at the lower sides and hem area, which reads as either an underlayer or integrated border panels. The black edging is repeated at the sleeve ends and along parts of the hem, giving the airy floral dress a darker graphic frame. The model carries a small light-toned patterned or beaded-looking bag from one hand on a slim strap or chain, and wears low black-and-white pointed footwear visible beneath the moving hem. Overall mood is romantic and fluid with a soft vintage floral surface contrasted by sharp black trim and dramatic layered hem proportions.
